title: Star Ballooning

services.name: Pilot, Balloons, Dog
services.desc: Mark Miller, the owner and pilot for Star Ballooning, fell in love with the sport at age 12 while helping his uncle fly hot air balloons in Bridgewater, Virginia. He got his student license in 2001 but it wasn't until 2013 that Mark finished his training to become a commercial hot air balloon pilot. Mark and his wife currently live in DC, but they regularly make the trek back to Mark's hometown in Virginia to fly. Shenandoah is our largest balloon, able to carry up to six passengers. The name, Shenandoah, is derived from an Algonquian word meaning "beautiful daughter of the stars." We love where we fly in the Shenandoah Valley and the connection this name has on multiple levels!!
